evidenceNotes: HRD Korea identifies the Laos EPS sending agency as Department of Employment of Lao PDR (DOE).

HRD Korea separately lists the current Laos reception office as Ministry of Labour and Social Welfare Employment Service Center (ESC), Souphanouvong road, Oubmong Village, Sikottabong District, Vientiane Capital.
HRD Korea lists 34th Point System Laos Manufacturing registration as 2026-09-07 through 2026-09-11; the test-date announcement, test date and result date remain undecided.
The 33rd Laos Manufacturing round is retained only as prior-round evidence: registration 2026-03-10 through 2026-03-13, test announcement 2026-04-01, test period 2026-04-20 through 2026-04-27.
Current 34th-round fee, quota, local document checklist, medical providers and downstream charges remain HOLD until a current detailed official notice is reviewed.

stages.title: Eligibility check
stages.action: Use HRD Korea's general EPS eligibility only as a preparation baseline; a local 34th-round Laos notice is still required for complete current conditions.

stages.title: 34th Point System registration
stages.authority: Ministry of Labour and Social Welfare Employment Service Center (ESC) / HRD Korea
stages.action: HRD Korea lists the 34th Laos Manufacturing registration period as 2026-09-07 through 2026-09-11. The window is closed.

stages.title: Application / test fee
stages.action: The official 34th-round fee has not yet been verified by KEP. Do not reuse another country or earlier-round fee.

stages.title: Identity verification
stages.action: Follow only the identity requirements in the current 34th-round official notice when available.

stages.title: Application document verification
stages.action: The exact 34th-round passport/photo/document checklist has not yet been verified. Do not reuse 33rd-round or another country's document rules.

stages.title: Test-date / admission notice
stages.action: The 34th Laos Manufacturing test-date announcement is currently undecided. Wait for the official test-date notice.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK — 34th Point System
stages.action: The 34th Laos Manufacturing route is listed as General CBT Point System; registration is verified but test and result dates are undecided.

stages.title: Skills / competency stage
stages.action: The current 34th-round skills schedule and detailed scoring notice have not yet been verified.

stages.title: Point-based final selection
stages.action: Final selection must follow the current 34th-round result/quota notice. KEP has not verified a current Manufacturing quota or cutoff.

stages.title: Country-specific pre-job checks
stages.action: No separate Laos psychology stage is currently verified.

stages.title: Medical examination
stages.action: Medical examination is part of the process baseline, but current 34th-round provider, fee and checklist are not yet verified.

stages.title: Employment-candidate file
stages.action: After selection, follow current Laos ESC/HRD Korea instructions. Exact 34th-round documents and timing remain unverified.

stages.title: EPS Job Seekers' Roster
stages.action: Only officially qualified candidates enter the EPS employer-selection process. Private intermediaries cannot guarantee priority.

stages.title: Korean employer selection
stages.action: Wait for employer selection through the official EPS system. No private intermediary can guarantee a specific employer.

stages.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
stages.action: If selected, follow the current Laos ESC/EPS instructions for the SLC and next steps.

stages.title: Post-SLC Laos requirements
stages.authority: Laos DOE / ESC / Ministry of Labour and Social Welfare
stages.action: Follow only current Laos official instructions for medical follow-up, training, visa, payments and departure preparation.

stages.title: Visa document package
stages.action: Use current Laos ESC/Korean-mission visa instructions. Exact 34th-round checklist and fees are not yet mapped.

stages.title: Pre-departure training
stages.authority: Laos DOE / Ministry of Labour and Social Welfare
stages.action: Pre-departure preparation is part of the Laos EPS process, but current 34th-round duration, location and fee remain unverified.

stages.title: Final health/departure readiness
stages.action: Do not invent an Indonesia-style MCU-III stage. Follow the current Laos notice if a final health check is required.

stages.title: Official departure
stages.action: Travel only after official EPS contract, visa, training and departure requirements are completed.

stages.title: Korea entry + employment education
stages.action: After entry, complete the official Korea-side employment education and handover process.

stages.title: Employer handover
stages.action: Confirm workplace, accommodation and emergency contacts during official handover.

stages.title: Residence Card / foreigner registration
stages.action: After arrival, follow current Korea Immigration rules for foreigner registration / Residence Card.

stages.title: EPS insurance check
stages.action: Confirm required EPS insurance obligations through official EPS information.

stages.title: First payroll check
stages.authority: Employer / Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Compare the first payslip and bank deposit with the SLC, working hours, deductions and applicable wage rules.

stages.title: Labor support readiness
stages.action: Keep official labor-support routes and contract/payroll evidence ready for any wage or labor issue.

stages.title: Employment / workplace-change readiness
stages.action: If a legally recognized workplace-change reason occurs, use Korea's official EPS or employment-center process and observe applicable deadlines.
